title: Token Intelligence by Faros: measure and optimize AI spend

hero.headline: Token Intelligence — trace exactly where your tokens are going
hero.subhead: Faros traces token consumption to what it delivers across people, teams, and outcomes — so you know what's productive, wasteful, and what to fix.

sections.heading: How we help
sections.body: Stop guessing where AI dollars go (visibility by team, tool, time vs budget baseline); find and plug inefficient token usage; route work to the most efficient model.

stats.label: of engineering leaders say ROI metrics are still missing (page stat)

sections.heading: Features — stop tokenmaxxing, start outcome maxxing
sections.body: AI ROI, Token Economics (productive vs wasteful), Budget Insights (keep/scope/cut tools), Team Accountability, Task-to-Tool Matching, Security First (no install on dev machines).

sections.heading: Spend
sections.body: Same visibility into AI spend you have into headcount/infra, plus a company baseline. See total spend by team/tool/model; track month-over-month growth; benchmark teams to spot outliers.

sections.heading: Efficiency
sections.body: Classifies spend by how deliberately AI was used. Buckets tokens into productive, inefficient, or wasteful — each with a dollar figure; trends the efficiency ratio over time.

sections.heading: Attribution
sections.body: AI spend mapped to team and task, measured against budget; shows who's on track, ahead, or underleveraging allocation; which tool works best for each task type.

sections.heading: Tools and models
sections.body: Keep, scope, or cut verdicts for every tool; identify the most cost-efficient model per type of work; arrive at vendor conversations knowing what each tool produced.

sections.heading: Why Faros — not a usage meter
sections.body: Engineering context that makes token data meaningful.

sections.heading: Works where your team works
sections.body: Connects to AI agents and tools via built-in telemetry, managed through central configuration; no installs.

sections.heading: The Playbook (field guide)
sections.body: Field guide to measuring token efficiency: three outcome signals, eleven guardrail metrics. Covers adoption, productivity, quality, and outcome metrics.

notes: This page is the live, named home of two capabilities the seed tree treats as Observe sub-capabilities: Engineering World Model and Token Attribution Ledger — both presented as shipped here. 'Productive / inefficient / wasteful' classification matches offering.json exactly. Page describes model-routing and task-to-tool matching as live (Optimize pillar, which offering.json marks 'partial' — see curator conflict note). Stats $2,000/eng/mo and 94% are page-stated marketing figures.
